svg.title: TEGE symbol set
svg.desc: Original marks for TEGE documents. Verdicts, depth bullets, input devices, engine nouns, structural marks, and the reach strip. Drawn from simple geometry so they survive at 16px and stay editable.

g.inkscape:label: 00 Paper
g.text: Built from squares, circles and straight lines so they hold together at 16px. No gradients, no fine detail, no outlined text.

g.inkscape:label: A Verdicts and depth
g.text: works, but not how you think
not there, has a gap ID
Depth is carried by the bullet, not by type size. Open a page anywhere and you know how deep you are without reading.

g.inkscape:label: B Input devices
g.text: Seven devices, because seven is what the engine actually supports. These sizes are for headings and legends. The reach strip below uses the same glyphs at 26px.

g.inkscape:label: E Reach strip
g.text: Who can actually perform this operation. Seven positions, ALWAYS in this order, so position three is the gamepad in every language.
Lit means yes. Hollow and struck means no. The letters below are a locale layer and can be switched off.
Place a floor in Creative Mode
example only, this row is not yet verified
verified, and this row is gap G2

g.inkscape:label: E2 Locale letters (switch off to test)
F Mirror these in right-to-left
g.text: MIRROR IN RIGHT-TO-LEFT LOCALES, AND ONLY THESE
sym-xref · sym-system · sym-ship · the reach strip ORDER
Everything else stays put. Mirroring a verdict, a device or an engine noun is the classic localisation bug.
